description: This file defines a React functional component called UserDashboard, which manages user interface logic for displaying user info, teams, keys, and onboarding flows in a dashboard context. It includes state management, effects for fetching data, token decoding, and rendering subcomponents like key creation and key table views.

methods.name: getCookie
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified cookie by name.

methods.name: formatUserRole
methods.description: Converts raw user role strings into human-readable format.

methods.name: gotoLogin
methods.description: Clears authentication cookies and redirects to the login URL.
